nodes.label: Bellatrix State at Fork Epoch Boundary
nodes.description: The beacon state is in Bellatrix format at the slot where slot % SLOTS_PER_EPOCH == 0 and epoch == CAPELLA_FORK_EPOCH

nodes.label: Execute upgrade_to_capella
nodes.description: Run the upgrade_to_capella function to transform the BeaconState from Bellatrix to Capella format

nodes.label: Upgrade ExecutionPayloadHeader

nodes.label: Capella State Active

nodes.label: No Fork Action Needed

sub_graphs.title: Capella: Skipped Slot Fork Handling
sub_graphs.description: Models the behavior when slots are skipped around the fork boundary

nodes.label: Slots Skipped Around Fork Boundary
nodes.description: One or more slots around CAPELLA_FORK_EPOCH boundary have been skipped (no block proposed)

nodes.label: Process Slots Through Fork Boundary
nodes.description: process_slots iterates through skipped slots, triggering the fork upgrade when the epoch boundary is reached

nodes.label: Fork Applied at Correct Epoch Boundary
nodes.description: The fork upgrade executes within process_slots at the exact epoch boundary slot, regardless of skipped slots

Fork triggered at exact epoch boundary within process_slots loop

ambiguities.text: The specification does not detail the behavior if CAPELLA_FORK_EPOCH is set to a past epoch when the node first syncs.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the fork upgrade is applied during historical sync when process_slots crosses the fork epoch boundary, same as for live operation.

ambiguities.text: The specification states 'implementations will need a modified state transition function' but does not define the exact boundary of these modifications.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the modification is confined to process_slots calling upgrade_to_capella at the epoch boundary, with no other state transition function changes required for the fork itself.

implicit_assumptions.description: All nodes in the network agree on the value of CAPELLA_FORK_EPOCH (194048) and CAPELLA_FORK_VERSION (0x03000000).
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Nodes with different fork epoch values would fork the chain at different points, causing a permanent chain split.

implicit_assumptions.description: The upgrade_to_capella function is executed atomically—either the full state upgrade completes or none of it does.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Partial state upgrades could leave the beacon state in an inconsistent intermediate format, potentially corrupting validator balances or withdrawal indices.
